check_self_hosted_runners: check the status of GitHub Actions self-hosted runners and report which ones are offline
get_runner_status: get the status of specific GitHub Actions self-hosted runners and raise an error if any are offline
check_offline_runners: check if specified GitHub Actions self-hosted runners are offline and save results to offline_runners.txt
parse_target_runners: parse a comma-separated list of runner names and a GitHub token from command-line arguments
run_runner_health_check: run a CLI health check on GitHub Actions self-hosted runners using --target_runners and --token arguments
